findings.evidence: `npm run build` (Next.js 14 static export) fails at the target: 'static/media/ort.node.min.*.mjs from Terser: import and export cannot be used outside of module code' followed by 'Build failed because of webpack errors'. Adding onnxruntime-web makes webpack resolve its Node entry (ort.node.min.mjs) and emit it as a media asset that Terser cannot parse. Step 1 recorded tsc/lint/Vitest only, not the build.
findings.impact: Merging would break the production build and Cloudflare Pages deployment of every page, not only the admin upscaler.
findings.recommendation: Make the build pass before merge: e.g. load ORT only from a client-only path that webpack does not trace for the server (webpack alias/externals for onnxruntime-web on the server compilation, or serve the browser ESM bundle and wasm from public/ and load it with a webpackIgnore dynamic import), then verify `npm run build` and that the ORT chunk is absent from initial routes.

findings.evidence: `import("onnxruntime-web")` resolves to dist/ort.bundle.min.mjs, which registers only the cpu, wasm, webgpu and webnn backends; the webgl backend is registered only in ort.webgl/ort.all bundles. InferenceSession.create(..., { executionProviders: ["webgl"] }) therefore cannot find a backend.
findings.impact: Even with a model file present, every upscale attempt throws and silently falls back to the canvas resizer, so the feature never improves image quality while still downloading the ORT chunk.
findings.recommendation: Use executionProviders ["wasm"] (optionally ["webgpu", "wasm"]) with the default bundle, gate availability on WebAssembly rather than WebGL, and add a test that asserts the requested providers.

findings.evidence: MODEL_URL points to /models/waifu2x.onnx, but no public/models directory or model file exists in the repository at the target, and the model's source, license, size and input/output contract (scale factor, padding, value range, channel order) are not documented.
findings.impact: The model request returns 404 in production, so the feature cannot work; shipping a third-party model also needs a license and size decision for the static export and PWA cache.
findings.recommendation: Decide whether to ship a specific waifu2x/ESRGAN ONNX model (record source, license, size and I/O contract in docs, add it under public/models, exclude it from the SW shell cache) or drop the AI path; add a contract test with a tiny fixture tensor.

findings.evidence: isProcessingIcon is only rendered as 'AI 고화질 변환 중...' in the admin page and RequestSubmissionModal; no submit button uses it in its disabled condition, and paste handlers start the conversion with `void ...`.
findings.impact: Acceptance criterion 4 (prevent duplicate submission during inference) is not met: saving while a pasted icon is still converting stores the previous or empty icon value.
findings.recommendation: Disable the save/submit buttons while isProcessingIcon is true (and return early in the submit handlers), with a test.

findings.evidence: The upscaled image is rebuilt from RGB only and every alpha value is forced to 255; the input alpha channel is discarded before inference.
findings.impact: Transparent PNG/WebP icons would get an opaque (typically black) background after upscaling, unlike the existing resizer path.
findings.recommendation: Upscale the alpha channel separately (e.g. bilinear resize of the source alpha) and recombine, or skip AI upscaling for images with transparency.

findings.evidence: A new InferenceSession is created for every conversion and never released; the toggle is shown on any desktop browser rather than only after a low-resolution image is detected (acceptance criterion 1).
findings.impact: Repeated uploads reload the model and keep GPU/WASM memory; the toggle appears even for high-resolution images where it has no effect.
findings.recommendation: Cache one session (or call session.release()), and show the toggle only once a selected file is detected as below 256px.
